name: Ocal Browser v10.0.01 Stable
body:
## 🌌 Ocal Browser v10.0.01 — Release Notes & Update Catalog

### 🧭 Introducing Onboarding Page for Fresh Users
* **Fresh Profile First-Run Experience**: Dedicated onboarding suite (`ocal://onboarding`) welcoming new users with streamlined search provider setup, dark/light theme selection, and privacy shield configuration.
* **Zero-Latency Standard Launch**: Returning users bypass onboarding automatically, booting directly into their custom Home workspace or restored session without delay.

### 🤖 AI Copilot Intelligence & @tab Command
* **Active Tab Context Aware**: Query, inspect, and summarize live webpages by simply typing `@tab` into the AI Copilot.
* **Multi-Tab Comparative Research**: Attach and cross-compare multiple active tabs side-by-side to synthesize pros/cons, documentation differences, and research notes with 100% local privacy.
* **High-Precision DOM Extraction**: Fast offline content scraper pulling semantic headings, structured article text, and OpenGraph metadata without third-party cloud leakage.

### ⚡ Chromium Runtime & Engine Upgrades
* **Latest Modern Engine Core**: Upgraded to the latest modern Electron (^44.9.0) and Chromium (134+) runtime stack.
* **Next-Gen Web Standards & Codecs**: High-performance V8 execution engine, WebGPU acceleration, and AV1/HEVC hardware-accelerated video decoding.
* **Chrome Extension Ecosystem**: Enhanced polyfills for Chrome Web Store extensions (Manifest V3), service worker lifecycles, and auto-sizing popups.

### 🚀 Core Performance Improvements
* **Sub-Second Tab Allocation**: Optimized window initialization pipeline for lightning-fast cold and warm startups on Windows 10 and 11.
* **Intelligent Tab Memory Saver**: Freezes background tabs after period of inactivity, saving up to 60% system memory while preserving exact scroll position.
* **Hardware-Accelerated ANGLE D3D11**: Direct3D 11 passthrough rendering pipeline delivering fluid 60+ FPS navigation.

### 🎨 UI Enhancements & Bug Fixes
* **Native Installer Button Controls**: Replaced plain text hyperlinks with genuine interactive Windows button controls (`TNewButton`) for Terms of Service, Privacy Policy, and EULA tabs.
* **Clean Stable Attribution**: Streamlined installer header with polished `Stable Version • By: Ocal Software` badge.
* **DPI & Layout Geometry**: Resolved context menu DPI distortion, prevented listener collisions, and eliminated split-screen border seams.

### 🛡️ Microsoft Authenticode & Code Signing
* **Dual Verification Compliance**: Built and signed with full SHA-256 Authenticode and RFC 3161 timestamps under `Gaming Network Studio` for Microsoft Store Policy 10.2.9 compliance.
* **Bundled Public Certificate**: Includes `GamingNetworkStudioMediaGroup.cer` ensuring trusted, warning-free installation across all Windows environments.

### 📦 Artifacts
* `Ocal-10.0.01-Setup.exe` (SHA-256 Signed Win32 Inno Setup Executable)
* `Ocal Browser 10.0.01.msix` & `Ocal Browser 10.0.01.appx` (Signed Microsoft Store Packages)
* `Ocal-MSIX-Setup.exe` (Dedicated MSIX installer with embedded certificate)
* `GamingNetworkStudioMediaGroup.cer` (Official Public Publisher Certificate for Windows & MS)
